tools.name: create_trial_inbox
tools.description: Get a disposable email address (a temporary inbox) for a signup or verification code, with NO Inbin account required at all -- usable before the human has signed up for anything. Returns the inbox address IMMEDIATELY; it does not wait for anything. Use the address to sign up wherever you need a conf

tools.name: await_trial_inbox
tools.description: Wait for the verification code or confirmation link email on a trial inbox: block (up to ttl_seconds, max 60) for the one confirmation email on a trial inbox created by create_trial_inbox. Pass the exact inbox_address that call returned. The inbox does NOT self-delete or become unusable after a matc

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "claim_trial_inbox" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status · Private data: claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status · Public sink: create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox, claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim · Destructive: await_trial_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status · Private data: claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status · Public sink: create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox, claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim · Destructive: await_trial_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
